title: Gesturize
subtitle: Dynamic sign language recognition
summary: Deep learning for recognising Indian Sign Language gestures from sequences of 3D hand landmarks.
contribution: I develop the gesture-classification models, addressing two-hand context, differences between users, and adaptation to new gestures.
details: Model work covers sequence representations, hybrid architectures, and transfer learning.
The system has been demonstrated through Sahaay at IIT Madras. Current work explores few-shot learning for custom gestures.

title: NanoCompile
subtitle: Neural network inference optimisation
summary: A compiler and optimisation project for trained neural networks, with work around ONNX Runtime.
contribution: I lead the team working on graph representations and inference optimisation.
details: Initial work covers graph IR, basic operator fusion, and constant folding.
The next stage focuses on GPU utilisation, CPU-to-GPU transfer, and memory use. These are active development goals, not claimed benchmark improvements.

title: Counzo
subtitle: Conversational wellbeing companion
summary: A mobile application with a conversational AI assistant, chat memory, and retrieval over a curated knowledge base.
contribution: I built the React Native application and FastAPI backend, integrating authentication, stored conversations, and a LangChain assistant.
details: Uses Supabase for authentication and data, with the backend hosted on Render.
Designed the mobile experience in Figma and developed it with Expo.

title: SpectRay
subtitle: A ray-tracing engine built from scratch
summary: A 3D rendering engine with ray intersections, diffuse lighting, reflection, refraction, and scene motion.
contribution: I implemented the rendering pipeline, scene objects, material behaviour, and acceleration structures.
details: Uses a bounding volume hierarchy to reduce unnecessary ray-intersection tests.
Supports textured materials, camera configuration, motion effects, and exploration of pixel-level parallelism.

title: FedEx Nexus
subtitle: Debt collection agency management
summary: A winning hackathon prototype for coordinating customer handoffs and agency workflows with agentic AI.
contribution: Our team designed an end-to-end workflow and full-stack prototype, alongside a proposed ML architecture.
details: The proposal included GRU-based predictions, NLP compliance checks, intent classification, and reinforcement-learning-based routing.
The design considered legacy integrations, customer experience, security, and compliance.

title: InterVisio
subtitle: Role-specific mock interviews
summary: An AI interview platform that uses resume or transcript context to generate questions and personalised feedback.
contribution: I worked on the frontend and a context-aware LangChain backend with retrieval and session handling.

title: Image captioning
subtitle: Visual features to language
summary: A CNN and RNN-based captioning engine developed through AI Club project work.
contribution: I reviewed the relevant literature and worked on the model architecture and implementation.

title: Air-gapped network copilot
subtitle: Secure MPLS operations
summary: A hackathon proposal for an offline agentic copilot to help operators anticipate and diagnose network issues.
contribution: Our team explored secure, locally running LLM systems for network operations and prepared a technical pitch.

title: Forest fire modelling
subtitle: Risk maps and spread simulation
summary: A proposal combining U-Net and LSTM models for fire-risk mapping, with cellular automata for spread simulation.
contribution: The design brought together land-use, weather, terrain, and settlement data, supported by a prototype interface.

title: Console Chess
subtitle: Rule-based chess in C
summary: A terminal chess interface with move rules and turn-taking, built as a computation course project.

title: GravitySim
subtitle: Force-field simulation
summary: A simulation of gravitational and electrical fields with numerical updates to position and velocity in 2D and 3D.

title: Virtual Cube Simulator
subtitle: Interactive 3D cube mechanics
summary: A Python simulator for cubes from 2 × 2 to n × n, with interactive controls and geometric rules for valid movement.

title: Voice assistant
subtitle: Speech input and output
summary: A rule-based assistant with online and offline speech recognition and synthesis, using VOSK, PocketSphinx, and Google audio services.

title: Space rover landing mechanism
subtitle: Multistage landing architecture
summary: A mechanical design project investigating a multistage landing mechanism for heavily loaded space rovers.

title: Neuromuscular orthosis
subtitle: Stance and gait support
summary: A course design project focused on walking support and correction of stance and gait cycles for older adults.

title: EV chassis design & analysis
subtitle: Structural modelling and simulation
summary: Modelled an electric-vehicle chassis and body surfaces in SolidWorks and analysed structural, thermal, and airflow behaviour in ANSYS.

title: BLDC speed & torque control
subtitle: Closed-loop motor control
summary: Developed MATLAB/Simulink models using six-step commutation and PID control to study motor speed and torque response.

title: Inline-four engine assembly
subtitle: Mechanical assembly and motion
summary: Modelled engine components and assembled them in Fusion 360 with motion constraints for the crankshaft, pistons, and valve train.

title: Thermal-sensing lighting PCB
subtitle: Schematic to manufacturing files
summary: Designed a dynamic lighting PCB in KiCAD, from sensor integration and component placement through electrical checks and Gerber export.
